title: 第一卷 第16章 拳头就是规矩
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
海河码头喧嚣无比。

    汽笛长鸣，镇涛号缓缓靠岸。

    几百号光膀子的汉子，喊着号子，将一箱箱贴着青帮封条的木箱往岸上搬。

    每一箱落地，都发出沉闷的撞击声。

    那都是大洋的声音，都是硬通货。

    海河帮总舵门口，早已围满了人。

    全是看热闹的。

    还有帮里其他堂口的头目，一个个面色铁青，眼神复杂。

    陆川站在船头，手里提着那根还在滴血的精铁长棍，神色淡漠。

    吴先生跟在他身后，手里捧着账本，腰弯成了九十度，脸上堆满了谄媚的笑。

    “陆爷，您慢点。”

    “小心台阶。”

    陆川没理会，一步跨下跳板。

    脚踩实地。

    就在这时，一道大喝声如惊雷般炸响。

    “站住！”

    人群自动分开一条道。

    一个身高近两米的壮汉大步走来。

    这壮汉赤着上身，肌肉虬结，手里拖着一把百斤重的精铁大锤。

    大锤在青石板上摩擦，火星四溅，发出刺耳的声响。

    他走到陆川面前三米处，停下。

    鼻孔喷着粗气，像头暴怒的公牛。

    “你就是陆川？”

    壮汉瞪着铜铃般的大眼，死死盯着陆川。

    陆川抬眼，扫了他一下。

    “有事？”

    “有事？”壮汉怒极反笑，指了指身后的镇涛号，“你坏了帮里的规矩！”

    “海河帮立帮三十年，最是重规矩！”

    “你一来就当副堂主，我不服！”

    周围一片死寂。

    有人认出了这壮汉。

    赵大桩。

    帮主赵海柱的独子。

    天生神力，使得一手好锤法，据说已经踏着练骨境。

    平日里在帮里横行霸道，没人敢惹。

    今天这是来找场子的。

    吴先生脸色一变，刚想上前打圆场。

    陆川却抬手拦住了他。

    “不服？”

    陆川看着赵大桩，语气平淡得像是在问今天天气如何。

    “你想怎么着？”

    赵大桩见陆川如此托大，更是火冒三丈。

    “是个男人就跟我练练！”

    “赢了，我赵大桩喊你一声陆爷，这副堂主的位置你坐！”

    “输了，你给老子滚出海河帮，从此以后别在津门地界混！”

    说完，他猛地一抖手腕。

    那百斤重的大锤呼啸而起，带着呼啸的风声，狠狠砸在陆川脚边的青石板上。

    “轰！”

    石板碎裂，碎石飞溅。

    赵大桩单手擎锤，锤头指着陆川的鼻子。

    “敢不敢？”

    陆川低头看了看脚边的碎石，又看了看那柄大锤。

    “你叫赵大桩？”

    “行不更名坐不改姓！”

    赵大桩一脸傲然道。

    “名字挺土。”

    陆川摇了摇头道，“锤法更土。”

    赵大桩怒吼一声：“找死！”

    他双臂肌肉暴起，青筋如蚯蚓般蠕动。

    大喝一声，手中大锤高高举起，带着开山裂石的气势，朝着陆川的天灵盖狠狠砸下。

    这一锤若是砸实了，别说人，就是头牛也得变成肉泥。

    周围的人群发出一阵惊呼。

    吴先生更是吓得闭上了眼。

    赵海柱不知何时出现在了人群后方，眉头紧锁，却没出声阻止。

    他也在看。

    看看陆川在这种情况下，会如何应对。

    面对这势大力沉的一锤，陆川没动。

    直到锤风压得他头发乱舞。

    没有花哨的招式，没有后退躲避。

    他只是微微侧身，抬起右脚。

    动作简单，快如闪电。

    “砰！”

    一声闷响。
content_en:
Haihe Pier is extremely noisy.

    The whistle blew, and the Zhentao slowly docked.

    Hundreds of shirtless men, shouting slogans, moved boxes of wooden boxes with Qinggang seals on them to the shore.

    Every box landed with a dull crashing sound.

    Those are the sounds of the ocean, and they are all hard currency.

    The entrance to the Haihe Gang's helmsman's office was already crowded with people.

    All for fun.

    There are also other leaders in the gang, all of whom have pale faces and complicated eyes.

    Lu Chuan stood at the bow of the ship, holding the fine iron long stick still dripping with blood in his hand, his expression indifferent.

    Mr. Wu followed him, holding a ledger in his hand, bending at ninety degrees, with a flattering smile on his face.

    "Master Lu, please slow down."

    "Watch the steps."

    Lu Chuan ignored it and stepped off the springboard.

    Keep your feet on the ground.

    At this moment, a loud shout sounded like thunder.

    "Stop!"

    The crowd automatically separated into a lane.

    A strong man nearly two meters tall strode over.

    This strong man was bare-chested, with bulging muscles, and he was dragging a 100-jin fine iron sledgehammer in his hand.

    The sledgehammer rubbed against the bluestone, causing sparks to fly and making a harsh sound.

    He walked three meters in front of Lu Chuan and stopped.

    His nostrils were snorting like a raging bull.

    "Are you Lu Chuan?"

    The strong man stared at Lu Chuan with his big copper bell-like eyes.

    Lu Chuan raised his eyes and glanced at him.

    "Is something wrong?"

    "Is something wrong?" The strong man laughed angrily and pointed at the Zhentao behind him, "You broke the rules of the gang!"

    "The Haihe Clan has been a gang for thirty years, and the most important thing is to follow the rules!"

    "You will be the deputy hall master as soon as you come here. I don't accept it!"

    There was dead silence.

    Someone recognized this strong man.

    Zhao Dazhuang.

    The only son of gang leader Jo Hae-joo.

    He is born with divine power and is good at hammering. It is said that he has reached the bone training realm.

    On weekdays, he acts domineeringly in the gang and no one dares to mess with him.

    Today I am here to find a place.

    Mr. Wu's expression changed, and he was about to step forward to smooth things over.

    But Lu Chuan raised his hand to stop him.

    "Not convinced?"

    Lu Chuan looked at Zhao Dazhuang, his tone as calm as if he was asking what the weather was like today.

    "What do you want?"

    Zhao Dazhuang was even more furious when he saw Lu Chuan being so patronizing.

    "If you're a man, just practice with me!"

    "If you win, I, Zhao Dazhuang, will call you Master Lu. You can take the position of deputy hall master!"

    "If you lose, get out of the Haihe Gang and don't hang out in Jinmen from now on!"

    After saying that, he jerked his wrist.

    The sledgehammer weighing a hundred kilograms roared up and hit the bluestone at Lu Chuan's feet with the sound of howling wind.

    "Boom!"

    The stone slabs shattered and rubble flew.

    Zhao Dazhuang held the hammer with one hand, pointing the hammer head at Lu Chuan's nose.

    "Do you dare?"

    Lu Chuan lowered his head and looked at the gravel at his feet, and then at the sledgehammer.

    "Your name is Zhao Dazhuang?"

    "I can't change my name, but I can't change my surname!"

    Zhao Dazhuang said proudly.

    "The name is quite tacky."

    Lu Chuan shook his head and said, "The hammering method is even more crude."

    Zhao Dazhuang roared angrily: "Seeking death!"

    The muscles in his arms bulged out, and the veins wriggled like earthworms.

    With a loud shout, he raised the sledgehammer high in his hand, and with the momentum of cracking mountains and cracking rocks, he slammed it down on Luchuan's Tianling Gai.

    If this hammer hits hard, not to mention people, even a cow will be turned into minced meat.

    The crowd around them exclaimed.

    Mr. Wu was so frightened that he closed his eyes.

    Zhao Haizhu appeared behind the crowd at some point, frowning but making no sound to stop him.

    He was watching too.

    Let's see how Lu Chuan would respond in this situation.

    Faced with this powerful and heavy blow, Lu Chuan did not move.

    Until the hammering wind made his hair flutter.

    No fancy moves, no retreating to dodge.

    He just turned slightly sideways and raised his right foot.

    The action is simple and lightning fast.

    "Bang!"

    There was a muffled sound.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 16 Fists are the rules
